summary: Iteration 4 (Chance/Borgi cards, Results screen, Ad bonus, central prices table, menu) fully verified on https://game-from-spec-1.preview.emergentagent.com. (1) Card dialog: landing on cell 2-1 (chance) opens dialog with data-testid=card-view/card-text/card-effect in RU (text visible, effect visible); switching to EN hides card-text (not rendered) and shows only card-effect summary (translated: 'Deflation: prices ÷2 (only during inflation)'). card-apply-btn present for standard cards; card-fine-btn/card-chance-btn appear for Borgi 'choice' card. History logs 'h.card' per draw. (2) Card effects verified deterministically by stacking m.decks: 'inflate' doubles gold price (100→200, DOM data-testid=gold-price-value reflects 200 and station price Pegasus 11 → 400$); 'patch' sets p.restrictions.patch=1; 'goto pegasus' animates token and places player at 15-1. (3) Price table: MPBoard.cells['3-1'].price === MPPrices.cells['vesta-11'].price (both 60). All ring1/ring2 cell data loaded from window.MPPrices with special.adBonus = {usd:100,rub:50,nar:0.5}. (4) Ad bonus flow: game-bonus-btn opens ad-player dialog; ad-claim-btn disabled initially, enabled after ~5s mock progress; claiming credits +100$ in kap_kap (human balance 2000→2100), opens result dialog with ad-close-btn and expected amount/balance; second attempt in same round is blocked (no ad dialog opens, toast shown); ad-cancel-btn does NOT credit bonus. (5) Menu dialog: game-menu-btn opens menu with menu-finish-btn, menu-bonus-btn, menu-rules-btn, menu-home-btn, menu-back-btn — all visible. (6) Finish/results: game-finish-btn → confirm-finish-btn opens screen-results with results-verdict ('Победитель: P2' with 12/12), 4 result-card-{color} and result-points-{color} per player (e.g. violet 12/12, others 10/12 after +100 bonus → correct capital tie-break). results-new-game-btn and results-home-btn work; after results-home-btn the start-continue-btn is hidden (match cleared). (7) Regression bot-only in all 5 scenarios (kap_kap, kap_nar, nar_nar, gos_gos, kap_gos) with every player made bot: ZERO JS/console/page errors across all 5. Bots exercise rolls, buy, build, blackhole exit (seen in history 'Штраф за выход из Black Hole'), construction payouts in gos (54 ₽), and card draws (card_hits 1–2 per scenario). (8) Mobile 390px: card dialog, ad dialog, and results screen all have document scrollWidth==clientWidth==390 (no horizontal overflow).
critical_code_review_comments: game.js is now 754 lines and growing (dialog + board + bots + flows + ads + results all in one IIFE). Please split for next iteration: game-render.js, game-flows.js (card/anomaly/joint/vote/auction), game-bots.js, game-results.js. This was already flagged in iteration 3 and is becoming maintenance debt.

cards.js draw() rebuilds the deck as a shuffled stack of 18 whenever decks[key] empties — fine, but the discard pile is lost on save/load (m.decks is persisted but once popped-indices never return as a discard set, so after 18 draws the next 18 may repeat the same cards within the same match). Acceptable for MVP; add a note or comment.

cards.js apply() 'goto' when target is 'c10' returns {path:['c10']} — the token therefore skips showing the intermediate forward path. Minor UX nit; a short animated path to c10 would feel more like a real teleport. Current behavior matches 'engine delivery'.

cards.js payCard() uses nar conversion only for kap_nar scenario; for nar_nar the deck currency is already 'nar'. All good, but the fiat/nar fallback logic has nested conditions that would benefit from a small switch block.

game.js adBonus() picks the first human when the current is a bot; the dialog subtitle correctly names that player, but game-bonus-btn is hidden on mobile under the burger menu — only the burger-expanded nav or Menu→Получить бонус works. Not a bug, but ensure the mobile menu is discoverable (burger button has data-testid='mobile-menu-btn' and it works).

game.js finishGame() calls window.MPState.Match.clear() AFTER m.save() — save then clear is intentional to ensure the saved copy is wiped (verified: start-continue-btn hidden after results-home). Add a code comment.

computeResults() uses Array.prototype.findIndex for ranking which gives the FIRST position of a tied value — correct (all ties get the same place and the same points). Confirmed with a 4-way tie on build/life where all 4 got 4 pts (place 1).
prices.js has no 'cur' or 'inflationFactor' field — inflation is applied at runtime via m.bank.applyIndex. Make sure anyone modifying prices.js knows the stored values are *base* (pre-inflation).
No end-of-game 'bankrupt' handling in results screen beyond the capital sum (negative capital is possible); harmless but consider showing a 'bankrupt' badge next iteration.
seed_data_creation: localStorage.clear() before each scenario; no persistent seed left behind.
